navaid.name: Grote Kaap
navaid.description: Remnants of an old navigational beacon. Wood dated to 1858, construction is generally dated to 1878. Torn down at the start of WWI.

navaid.name: Kleine Kaap
navaid.description: Remnants of a beacon used for navigation. Tentatively dated to 1828 based on dendrology of the wooden posts.
Two stumps within 10 cm of each other
Surveyed by Stichting Verdronken Geschiedenis on 2010-11-06. Described as the southernmost post of a row of 6 extending north, with 100 m interval.
Three short posts. Surveyed by Stichting Verdronken Geschiedenis on 2010-11-06. Likely a survey point by Rijkswaterstaat.
Reported to be present in 2010 and 2020. Wash features visible in 2011 aerial imagery. Original function unknown.
Remnants of a beacon used for navigation. Reported to be present in 2010 and 2020. Wash features still visible in 2023 aerial imagery.
